newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: MUSIC GROUP FORM GETS NOD FOR SINGAPORE LISTING.
newsitem.headline: MUSIC GROUP FORM GETS NOD FOR SINGAPORE LISTING.

text.p: Music and video production group Form Holdings said on Tuesday it has received approval from the Stock Exchange of Singapore to list on the second board, SEADAQ.
Form said in a statement it distributes and licenses entertainment and educational products and owns two commercial recording studios in Singapore.
It has a distribution network of more than 500 retail stores in Singapore, Malaysia and Hong Kong.
Turnover for the group grew at a compounded annual growth rate of 18 percent, from Singapore $16 million in 1994 to S$22.7 million in 1996.
Pretax profit was S$2.9 million in 1996, up from S$1.0 million in 1994.
